decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The permission hereby granted shall be for a limited period of ten years
for the erection of the marquee from 1st May to 30th September for each
consecutive year and the permission shall expire on 30th September
2023 when the use shall cease and the marquee removed within one
week of that date. The site of the marquee shall be made good, levelled
and laid to grass no later than one month after its removal for each
yearly period.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, Existing site plan, Proposed Site plan, Perspective view
received 26/7/12, Amended elevation, Additional Statement, Appendix A,
B and C received 9/10/12, Concerto group employment letter received 10/5/13
Viewpoint photos received 12/5/13, Trip generation note and Draft Travel Plan received 16/5/13 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Samples of materials - No development shall take place until
samples of the materials to be used in the external surfaces of
the marquee have been submitted to and approved in writing by
the Local Planning Authority. Details shall be implemented as
approved.

Condition : 4 - No excavations shall take place for the construction of, or for the
purposes of the use of the marquee.

Condition : 5 - No more than 50 events shall take place per season unless agreed in writing with
the Local Planning Authority. A list of events taken place shall be permanently recorded and provided to  the Local Planning Authoirty at their request.
Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for marquee event  purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 10am to 12 midnight Monday to Saturdays and 10am to 11pm on Sundays.

Condition : 7 - No development shall take place until a car park management scheme has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This will include details of measures to ensure that visitors or staff cars associated with the use parked in no place other than the main public car park or in the Lime Avenue car parking area (using the latter
only in the event that the main public car park is already full) or the designated disabled persons? parking spaces shown on the plans hereby approved and shall ensure that these car parking areas are shown in the submitted application are available exclusively to visitors and staff at the event.

Condition : 8 - The submitted travel plan (visitor welcome pack) shall be implemented as approved and maintained throughout the life of the permission. Specifcally the welcome pack shall be provided to all event visitors.

Condition : 9 - Delivery and service plan ? The marquee shall not be erected until a
delivery and service plan has been submitted to and approved in writing
by the Local Planning Authority. The plan shall be implemented as
approved.

Condition : 10 - No firework displays shall take place in conjunction with any event held
in or adjoining the Marquee hereby approved.

Condition : 11 - Before the marquee is first used, each year, a sound limiter
(environmental noise control system) shall be installed in the marquee in
accordance with details that shall first be submitted to and approved in
writing by the local planning authority to control noise levels. The sound
system (or at least the power amplifier(s)) are to be permanently
installed at the venue, maintained in an operational state and kept
switched on at all times when amplification is used and no sound checks
are to be carried out outside the permitted hours of use.

Condition : 12 - For the duration of any event to be held in the marquee, the organisers
shall take measures to ensure that visitors or staff do not enter the
adjacent area of nearby Site of Special Scientific interest.

Condition : 13 - Accessibility to the marquee for wheelchair users shall be provided in accordance with specifcations note din teh deisgn and access statement and shall be maintained whislt the marquee is in use.

description: Change of use of garden to erect a temporary marquee every year for 10 years between 1st May and 30th September for daytime and evening private/ corporate events from 2014 to 2023 Inclusive
